name: collaborative-whiteboard
description: Real-time collaborative whiteboard built with React, Fabric.js, Yjs, and MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test:client
